listing.name: Daggerfall Unity
listing.summary: Daggerfall Unity offers upstream packages for The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall. Follow upstream setup before registering your executable.

steps.title: Install or keep your existing copy
steps.instruction: Install uses the official portable runtime with updates managed by Portcove. Installation options retain a non-owning route for an existing, upstream-managed or customized copy.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: On first Play, use Daggerfall Unity’s setup wizard to select your compatible original Daggerfall game folder. It validates the game data. The package is a native Unity player and needs no separate game compilation. Keep external originals where they are.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: Normal saves, settings, logs, screenshots and mod data live in Unity’s Daggerfall Workshop/Daggerfall Unity user-data directory, outside Portcove backups. The reviewed Portable.txt mode uses PortableAppdata beside the player; that folder and the marker are declared. StreamingAssets/Mods and optional StreamingAssets/GameFiles are retained as supported user additions. Other replacements of version-owned assets require manual preservation or external registration. Mods and saves must remain compatible with the selected runtime.
